FreeToolCo Privacy Policy

FreeToolCo is designed around simple, transparent, browser-first privacy.

Browser-first processing

FreeToolCo is a static browser-first website. The included tools use local browser APIs and bundled local scripts. For these tools, processing happens in your browser after the page has loaded.

Network requests

The production build does not require third-party CDNs for core tool processing. If analytics or advertising is added later, update this policy before launch.

No fake download buttons

The interface is intentionally clean and avoids misleading ads or confusing download buttons.

Contact

For privacy questions, email contact@freetoolco.com.
